register.name: India Code (Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice)
register.access_notes: Direct scripted access is blocked. A curl request with an honest UA (canon-index-builder/1.0) to https://www.indiacode.nic.in/ got an Akamai 'Access Denied' 403. labour.gov.in, incometaxindia.gov.in, legislative.gov.in and pib.gov.in returned the same 403, and WebFetch also got a 403 from PIB. I stopped hitting those sites and did not try to get around the block. Fallback evidence: (1) the Legal Data Hunter MCP source IN/IndiaCode, which holds India Code text including commencement footnotes; (2) the IN/eGazette mirror of the Gazette of India on archive.org; (3) Wayback Machine copies of India Code pages and PDFs (homepage, disclaimer.jsp, the handle page for the Code on Social Security, and Act PDFs). Legal Data Hunter began rate-limiting partway through the run and stayed limited for about 20 minutes, so some Acts could not be checked.

licence.summary: No open licence found. India Code publishes no copyright licence; the Wayback copy of its disclaimer.jsp has only an 'as is' disclaimer and an English-prevails clause. The statutory exception is Copyright Act 1957 s.52(1)(q)(ii): reproducing or publishing an Act of a Legislature is not infringement only if it comes with commentary or other original matter. Gazette matter other than Acts is freely reproducible under s.52(1)(q)(i). Bare reproduction and adaptation of Act text is therefore not clearly permitted without that condition.
licence.quote: any Act of a Legislature subject to the condition that such Act is reproduced or published together with any commentary thereon or any other original matter (Copyright Act 1957 s.52(1)(q)(ii), from the India Code PDF via Wayback)

acts.title: The Code on Wages, 2019
acts.verified_how: LDH IN/IndiaCode doc IN_IndiaCode_201929 gives the short title and the India Code handle 15793. Its s.1 footnote shows only partial commencement on 18 Dec 2020 (S.O. 4604(E)), which is an older snapshot. Full commencement on 21 Nov 2025 comes from a PIB release ('Government Makes the Four Labour Codes effective...', PRID 2192463) seen only in search results because PIB blocked the fetch. The same-day commencement of the IRC and OSH Codes is confirmed in India Code text (S.O. 5320(E) and 5321(E), dated 21 Nov 2025).
acts.notes: Wholly in force since 21 Nov 2025. Subsumes the Minimum Wages Act 1948, Payment of Wages Act 1936, Payment of Bonus Act 1965 and Equal Remuneration Act 1976 (repeal section recalled as s.69, not re-read). Central rules were reported as still pending at commencement, with transitional reliance on existing rules. Wages are also administered by the States as 'appropriate Government'.

acts.title: The Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020
acts.verified_how: LDH IN/IndiaCode doc IN_IndiaCode_2020-37 has the short title and, in its s.1 footnote, '21st day of November, 2025, vide Notifn. No. S.O. 5321 (E), dated 21st day of November, 2025'.
acts.notes: Annual leave with wages (formerly under the Factories Act 1948) is now in this Code. It replaces 13 older Acts, including the Factories Act, the Contract Labour Act and the Inter-State Migrant Workmen Act. Shops-and-establishments leave rules remain State law.

acts.title: The Code on Social Security, 2020
acts.verified_how: LDH IN/IndiaCode doc IN_IndiaCode_202036 gives the title. A Wayback copy (14 Mar 2026) of India Code handle 16823 shows 'Act ID: 202036 Act Number: 36 Enactment Date: 2020-09-28'. Commencement on 21 Nov 2025 comes from the PIB release seen in search results, alongside the IRC and OSH commencement footnotes on India Code. The SS Code's own s.1 footnote is outside the retrieved 2 KB and was not read.
acts.notes: Listed here for maternity benefit (the Maternity Benefit Act 1961 is subsumed).

acts.title: The Industrial Relations Code, 2020
acts.verified_how: LDH IN/IndiaCode doc IN_IndiaCode_2020-35 has the short title and, in its s.1 footnote, '21st day of November, 2025 --- vide Notification No. S.O. 5320(E), dated 21st November, 2025'.
acts.notes: Covers retrenchment, lay-off, closure and retrenchment compensation. Replaces the Industrial Disputes Act 1947, Trade Unions Act 1926 and Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act 1946.

acts.title: The Code on Social Security, 2020
acts.verified_how: Same as the Code on Social Security entry under Leave/holiday pay: LDH doc, the Wayback copy of the India Code handle page, and the PIB release on commencement.
acts.notes: Gratuity on termination (formerly the Payment of Gratuity Act 1972, now subsumed).

acts.title: The Code on Social Security, 2020
acts.verified_how: As above: LDH IN/IndiaCode doc IN_IndiaCode_202036; Wayback copy of India Code handle 16823 (Act Number 36, 2020); PIB release on the 21 Nov 2025 commencement.
acts.notes: Subsumes 9 Acts, including the EPF & MP Act 1952 (EPF and EPS pensions), the ESI Act 1948, the Employees' Compensation Act 1923, the Maternity Benefit Act 1961, the Payment of Gratuity Act 1972 and the Unorganised Workers' Social Security Act 2008.

acts.title: The National Food Security Act, 2013
acts.verified_how: Fetched a Wayback copy (6 Feb 2026) of the India Code PDF. It shows 'THE NATIONAL FOOD SECURITY ACT, 2013' and 'ACT NO. 20 OF 2013', a current consolidated text hosted on India Code. No repeal was found.
acts.notes: Legal entitlement to subsidised foodgrains through the targeted PDS. Distribution is implemented by the States.

acts.title: The Viksit Bharat—Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin): VB—G RAM G (विकसित भारत—जी राम जी) Act, 2025
acts.identifier: Act of 2025 (LDH record id IN_IndiaCode_2025-36 suggests Act No. 36 of 2025; not confirmed)
acts.verified_how: LDH IN/IndiaCode search hit gives the title, the date 2025-12-20 and handle 22478; s.1 provides for commencement by notification. A PIB release (PRID 2259712), seen only in web search results, says the Act is in force from 1 July 2026 and that MGNREGA 2005 stands repealed from that date. The Gazette notification was not read.
acts.notes: Rural employment guarantee. It replaces the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act 2005, if the 1 July 2026 commencement is confirmed. Check the Act number and commencement notification when India Code is reachable.

acts.title: The Income-tax Act, 2025
acts.verified_how: LDH IN/eGazette doc in.gazette.central.e.2025-08-21.265620 is the Gazette of India Extraordinary, Part II s.1, No. 35, 21 Aug 2025. It shows 'THE INCOME-TAX ACT, 2025 No. 30 OF 2025' and s.1(3): 'Save as otherwise provided in this Act, it shall come into force on the 1st April, 2026.' Today (22 Sep 2026) is after that date. The India Code handle for this Act was not found because the site blocks access.
acts.notes: Replaces the Income-tax Act 1961 (Act 43 of 1961) from 1 Apr 2026, with savings for earlier assessment years. Salary TDS/withholding is in this Act. The URL is the Gazette mirror; replace it with the India Code handle when reachable.

acts.title: The Insurance Act, 1938
acts.verified_how: Wayback CDX shows an India Code PDF at bitstream/123456789/2304/1/a1938-04.pdf, which matches India Code's naming convention for Act 4 of 1938. The archived PDF itself came back as an Akamai 403 page, and the LDH lookup was rate-limited, so the title and status were not read from the text.
acts.notes: Principal insurance statute. s.45 limits repudiation of life policies, and claim settlement is governed through IRDAI regulations. Believed in force as amended (most recently by the Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha amendments), but not checked.

acts.title: The Carriage by Air Act, 1972

acts.title: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019
acts.verified_how: LDH IN/IndiaCode search hit IN_IndiaCode_201935 gives the short title 'The Consumer Protection Act, 2019', enactment 2019-08-09, handle 15256, and commencement by notification with a footnote. It replaced the Consumer Protection Act 1986.
acts.notes: Covers consumer rights, unfair trade practices, product liability and Consumer Commissions. Tenancy is State law (see topic_gaps).

acts.title: The Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025
acts.verified_how: LDH IN/IndiaCode search hit IN_IndiaCode_2025-13 has the title 'The Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025', enactment 2025-04-04 and handle 21918. Its s.1 footnote reads '1st day of September, 2025'.
acts.notes: Replaces the Passport (Entry into India) Act 1920, Registration of Foreigners Act 1939, Foreigners Act 1946 and Immigration (Carriers' Liability) Act 2000 (recalled, not re-read). Visas and employment visas for foreigners are under this Act and its orders and rules.

acts.title: The Emigration Act, 1983
acts.verified_how: LDH IN/IndiaCode search hit IN_IndiaCode_198331 has the short title 'The Emigration Act, 1983', enactment 1983-09-10 and handle 1779. The Act number comes from the LDH id (year 1983, number 31).
acts.notes: Covers emigration clearance and recruiting agents for Indian workers going abroad. An Overseas Mobility Bill to replace it has been proposed, but no replacement Act was found.

topic_gaps.reason: Residential tenancy is State law (rent control Acts of each State or UT). The Model Tenancy Act 2021 is a model for States, not a central Act. Only the consumer half is covered centrally (Consumer Protection Act 2019).

Only electricity has a central Act. Water and sewerage billing is State or municipal law. Retail electricity tariffs and billing codes are set by State Electricity Regulatory Commissions under the Electricity Act. Telecom billing sits under TRAI regulations; the Telecommunications Act 2023 was not verified or listed.

Air passenger compensation for denied boarding, cancellation and delay is in DGCA Civil Aviation Requirements Section 3 Series M Part IV (subsidiary rules), not an Act. The Act-level statutes (Carriage by Air Act, Railways Act) could not be verified this run.

India (central / Union legislation).language_authenticity: English is authoritative. Under Article 348(1)(b) of the Constitution, the authoritative texts of Acts of Parliament are in English. Under the Authoritative Texts (Central Laws) Act 1973 and s.5 of the Official Languages Act 1963, Hindi translations published under the President's authority are deemed authoritative Hindi texts. Constitutionally, though, the English text is the authoritative one. India Code's disclaimer (Wayback copy of disclaimer.jsp) says that in any discrepancy 'the English version of the Acts shall prevail'. Article 348 itself was cited from knowledge and not re-fetched this run.
problems: India Code (indiacode.nic.in) returns an Akamai 'Access Denied' 403 to scripted requests with an honest UA. labour.gov.in, incometaxindia.gov.in, legislative.gov.in and pib.gov.in also returned 403 (WebFetch got a 403 from PIB). No workaround was attempted, and the official register pages were not read directly.

Legal Data Hunter began rate-limiting about a third of the way through, probably because of the 13 parallel agents, and stayed limited for 20+ minutes. As a result the Railways Act 1989, Carriage by Air Act 1972 and Insurance Act 1938 remain 'unverified', and the Telecommunications Act 2023 and PFRDA Act 2013 were not checked.

Labour Codes: India Code text confirms the IRC 2020 and OSH Code 2020 commenced on 21 Nov 2025 (S.O. 5320(E) and 5321(E)). For the Code on Wages 2019 and the Code on Social Security 2020, commencement on the same date rests on a PIB release seen only in search results. The LDH copy of the Code on Wages still shows only the 2020 partial commencement. The central rules under the Codes were reported as not yet final at commencement, so check transitional rule savings before encoding.
The VB-G RAM G Act 2025 (replacing MGNREGA 2005) is reported by PIB as in force from 1 July 2026; the Gazette notification and the Act number were not confirmed.
Income-tax Act 2025 (No. 30 of 2025): the URL is the Gazette of India mirror on archive.org, because the India Code handle could not be found while the site was blocked.
The repeal lists and section numbers cited in notes (for example Code on Wages s.69, the list of Acts replaced by the Immigration and Foreigners Act) were recalled, not re-read from the text.

Licence: India Code publishes no reuse licence. Reproducing bare Act text relies on Copyright Act s.52(1)(q)(ii), which requires accompanying commentary or original matter. A human should decide whether canon's L4 encodings plus annotations meet that condition, or seek permission from the Legislative Department.
